module purpose: Synchronous boot ROM: on each clk_i the module indexes an internal constant ROM (mem_rom_c) with the requested bus address and registers the selected 32-bit word into rdata; when a bus read is requested (bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw='0') the module asserts rden and drives bus_rsp_o.data with rdata and bus_rsp_o.ack with rden (bus_rsp_o.err is tied '0').

use-case flows.value: read request: the read strobe (bus_req_i.stb with bus_req_i.rw='0') that begins producing a read-enable
ROM read: sample the requested address and register the selected 32-bit ROM word into rdata on the clock edge
deliver the registered ROM word to the bus (bus_rsp_o.data) when the read-enable is asserted
report transaction status: drive bus_rsp_o.ack from rden and drive bus_rsp_o.err low
clear the read-enable state (rden) when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Boot ROM read value — the 32-bit ROM word selected from mem_rom_c and returned to the bus
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access process indexes the constant ROM with the presented bus address and registers the selected word into rdata on the rising edge of clk_i (assignment at line 48). The registered word is then driven onto the bus as bus_rsp_o.data when rden = '1' (conditional assignment at line 64). The relationship map records that rdata is CLOCKED_BY clk_i at its occurrence for the line-48 assignment and that bus_rsp_o.data DERIVES_FROM rdata and is GATED_BY rden at the line-64 assignment (see the map records cited in the related structural assets). Therefore the integrity of the ROM word read-and-return flow is established by these RTL statements and records.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable decision (rden) — the registered decision that gates data output and produces the acknowledge
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process computes and registers the read-enable as rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on the rising edge of clk_i (line 60) and resets it when rstn_i = '0' (lines 57–58). The map records a CLOCKED_BY relationship for rden at the line-60 assignment and a GATED_BY relationship showing the guard 'bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)' that targets rden. rden is copied to bus_rsp_o.ack (line 65; map: bus_rsp_o.ack COPIES rden) and also gates bus_rsp_o.data (line 64; map: bus_rsp_o.data GATED_BY rden). Hence the integrity of rden is established because it controls whether data and acknowledge are presented.

conceptual assets.concept: Requested ROM address — the address presented on bus_req_i.addr that selects which ROM word is read
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access assignment indexes mem_rom_c using a slice of bus_req_i.addr to produce the read word assigned to rdata (the indexing expression appears in the rdata assignment at line 48). The relationship map records that bus_req_i.addr SELECTS rdata at the line-48 assignment and that rdata is SELECTED_BY bus_req_i.addr. Thus the address on bus_req_i.addr is the setting point that determines which ROM word is returned, establishing its integrity as part of the read flow.
